rows.exercised: Its steps are the normal playthrough’s through orientation and the first showing (the runs above); its leaning, its unprepared scene and the note taken, and its four hours of Graded Exposure were played in the engine through the commands to check the document’s figures (probes in the scratchpad: Composure 58.3 at Emotional Stability 95; the scene left alone Shown Unready at 22 of 100 on 8 September, the note taken the next day and the band still Unready; 58.3 to 58.6 after four hours, the fifth refused in the day’s words). Those probes check the document, not the interface.

expectationsWrong.found: it lists Monday’s commitments by their course, “Drama 50: The Theatrical Event — September 14, 2026 at 3:00 PM”
expectationsWrong.why: “lab” is the engine’s kind for them, not their name on the screen; the tool’s check looked for the word, and now looks for Monday’s date

expectationsWrong.expected: higher than at the first take
